children: Brinker introduced long-term targets through fiscal 2029, including revenue and EPS growth, unit expansion and annual share repurchases.
Targets 4%–6% annual revenue growth through fiscal 2029, driven by company expansion and sales momentum.
Plans 2%–3% annual unit growth, ramping to ~30 new restaurants per year across new trade areas by fiscal 2029.
Forecasts double-digit annual growth in net income per diluted share, excluding special items (non-GAAP).
Proposes annual share repurchases of 3%–5%, subject to board approval of incremental authorizations.
